- **MA-1** [spec-bug] Changed the expected `limits` in the existing configSchema.spec.ts 'fills every default' case from { sessionMinLeft: 15, weeklyMinLeft: 5 } to also include accounts: {}. — The brief requires `limits.accounts` to default to {}, so the exact-equality assertion of the full parsed default config can't pass unchanged; the only change is the new default key.
- **MA-1** [scope] Changed the parameter type of decide() in src/limits/policy.ts from Config['limits'] to AccountLimits. — Config['limits'] now requires `accounts`, which broke the existing policy.spec.ts literals at compile time. AccountLimits is the narrower type decide actually uses, so it is a type-only change and the existing tests stay as they are.
